post_motion_drain.reason: Post-motion inference validation deadline elapsed. This is not an estimator numerical failure or a claim that all observations were processed.
post_motion_drain.assimilation_scope: all selected effective observations only; raw/disabled/time-thinned acquisitions are retained and explicitly accounted, not claimed assimilated

timing_boundaries: Host wall/monotonic stage and queue clocks are compared only with their own clock; synthetic acquisition stamps are not subtracted from host epochs. Runtime stage durations are nested and must not be summed as disjoint total runtime. Command source-age statistics use only actually integrated intervals, excluding after-motion adoptions. Five-second body/display age samples are explicitly sampled, not an all-tick maximum. No GPU-render completion is measured.

nested_stage_exclusive_accounting.method: For each paired stage_finished, interval=[monotonic_s-duration_s,monotonic_s]. Subtract the clipped union of completed direct-child intervals from the reported inclusive duration. Direct-child intervals already include their descendants. Same-process only; stage_finish within the physical-window host-wall boundaries; this is a measured-stage accounting estimate including monitor boundary/recording overhead, not an exact profiler attribution to code lines. Uninstrumented residual work is not identified as DB/JSON/checkpoint-only work.
